title: Detection of Unsuspected Small Airways Obstruction in Cystic Fibrosis
official: The Measurement and Analysis of Maximal Expiratory Flow Volume Loops at Low Lung Volumes in Children With Cystic Fibrosis and Normal Routine Lung Function.
summary: Goal is to physiologically detect unsuspected small airways obstruction in children and adults with treated heterozygous and homozygous cystic fibrosis. Unsuspected refers to normal routine pre bronchodilator spirometry including normal FEV1(L), FVC (L). and FEV1/FVC%. This is a retrospective study.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Heterozygote or homozygote patients with cystic fibrosis with normal routine pre bronchodilator spirometry including normal FEV1(L), FVC(L) and FEV1/FVC%.

Exclusion Criteria:Heterozygote or homozygote patients with cystic fibrosis with ABNORMAL routine pre bronchodilator spirometry
